comparison.objective: Hold an LED flush while touching a soldering-iron tip to its pad, then return the iron; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual component retention and sustained precise hot-tool contact versus coaxial mandrel retention, dynamic hammer impact, withdrawal, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: LED held flush, tip contacts a pad for two seconds, and iron is returned tip-first versus four contact-loaded fractures, four recovered tangs, and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: This is a plausible neighbor in bimanual precision tool use, but sustained solder-pad contact tests a different force regime and outcome from impact fracture and fragment accounting.
